import nanosurf
import time

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan

start_time = time.time()

scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:

    print(f"Scan 1 in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

scan1_time = time.time() - start_time
print(f"Scan 1 finished in {scan1_time:.2f} seconds")

del spm
"}
